english.note: Use this when protecting by standing guard over a person, place, position, or boundary.

examples.english: Please protect the doorway for me while I go get help.
examples.traditional: 你幫我守住個門口，我去叫人。
examples.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 sau2 zyu6 go3 mun4 hau2 ngo5 heoi3 giu3 jan4

english.note: Use this when keeping means guarding or holding something confidential, as in 守住個秘密.

examples.english: You have to keep this secret.
examples.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 sau2 zyu6 ni1 go3 bei3 mat6
